· CAREERS AT FUNNGRO ·

Most of the team started as users.

Funngro is built by the people who use it. If you're a Teenlancer, that's a head-start. If you're not yet, download the app first — that's how everyone here started.

· HOW WE WORK ·

01
Most of us started as users.

We grow the team from the platform first. Earner → Clan Lead → full-time team is a real path here.

02
Remote-first across India.

Mumbai is HQ. The team lives wherever the Teenlancers live.

03
Ship every week.

Small teams, fast cycles. Engineers see their code in production within days.

04
Open salary bands.

We publish bands at offer time. No negotiation games.
